admission.claim: The JPEG frame-header parser accepts only supported component counts and nonzero bounded per-component horizontal and vertical sampling factors, storing them in internal component state.
admission.observation: The supplied source shows the SOF header path admitting component counts of 1, 3, or 4 and rejecting any H or V nibble outside the nonzero 1..4 range, so the decoder records component subsampling state only after those checks.

root.claim: During JPEG load, each component’s resampling scale is derived by integer division of the maximum frame factors by that component’s factors, so unsupported fractional ratios are truncated into integer expansion factors.
root.observation: The load path computes per-component hs and vs as maximum-factor divided by component-factor using ordinary integer semantics; if the maxima are not exact multiples, the resulting stored values are the truncated integer quotients.

propagation.claim: Those derived integer expansion factors are then matched only against the exact supported dispatch cases, and any other value class is sent to the generic row resampler.
propagation.observation: The resampler selection compares the computed factors only to the exact 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2 predicates, with all remaining factor combinations dispatched to the generic resampling path.

target.claim: The authoritative failure mode is an unsupported JPEG component-resampling path reached from admitted fractional subsampling ratios.
